binding_order: After native lifecycle, application generation and recovery attribution
ownership: Device and Bootstrap retain the original shared Notifications Arc
Each BootData and Execution callback carries its immutable generation token
A pending notification epoch is created before RTKit rearm; current frontend epoch changes only after fresh graph/open_control success
Old sticky crash tombstones remain retained; stale callbacks update only their original tombstone
Frontend failure uses a monotonic generation latch so delayed old timeout cannot erase or poison fresh failure state
Old File descriptors return ESTALE and retain their VM/mapping state when closed
Old scheduler jobs cannot enqueue into the fresh application; already submitted jobs are not replayed
actual_restart_call: DRM worker terminal pipeline-error boundary while engine/runtime locks are held; calls native_restart once per generation; failure remains quarantined; old fences receive the original error
admission: No BUNDLE_COMPLETE/POWER_COMPLETE gate is opened by this adapter
validation: Whole integrated external-module compilation belongs to parent; no component tests performed
